title: Good app
body: Great easy to use app. Would appreciate more customisability in naming the habits I track.
author: Sourworms1989

title: Easy and Enjoyable!
body: The icons and colors are eye catching, so it’s not a bore to use. The interface is very easy to navigate. I love trying to keep my streak up, it is really helping me to achieve my goals so far!
author: PMJay81
